risk_if_not_implemented: Without Management Approval For External Media Transfer, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15).

compensating_control_1.name: Physical Access Control
compensating_control_1.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to enforce physical access authorizations for all physical access points (including designated entry/exit points) to facilities (excluding those areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible).
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical Access Control (PES-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Management Approval For External Media Transfer (AST-18.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Media Storage
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to: 
(1) Physically control and securely store digital and non-digital media within controlled areas using organization-defined security measures; and
(2) Protect system media until the media are destroyed or sanitized using approved equipment, techniques and procedures.
compensating_control_2.justification: Media Storage (DCH-13) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Management Approval For External Media Transfer (AST-18.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
